prompt: Create a close-up cinematic portrait photograph of a young East Asian woman turning her head over her bare shoulder and looking directly into the camera with a calm, slightly introspective expression. Frame her from the upper chest to the top of the head in a vertical 4:5 composition, face slightly left of center, shoulder in the foreground, neck elongated, head tilted subtly downward and back toward the viewer. She has dark brown-black hair loosely pinned up in a messy bun with fine stray strands across the forehead, temples, cheek, and nape, catching the light. Define the facial structure clearly: oval face, soft jawline, delicate cheekbones, straight natural brows, almond-shaped dark brown eyes with small catchlights, a softly rounded nose bridge and tip, natural full lips, visible skin pores, faint under-eye texture, tiny beauty marks on the cheek and neck, and realistic uneven skin sheen. Use warm late-afternoon directional backlight from behind the right side, with soft chiaroscuro across the face: a golden rim light outlining the hair, cheek, shoulder, and neck, gentle shadow on the far side of the face, specular highlights on the eyes and lips, and no flat frontal lighting. She wears a thin gray spaghetti-strap top, only the strap and bare shoulder visible. Background is an indistinct warm gray-brown interior or shaded outdoor wall, heavily blurred with shallow depth of field, subtle haze, soft bokeh, and a filmic natural color grade. Make it look like an intimate 85mm lens portrait on full-frame camera, very shallow depth of field, natural grain, imperfect organic realism, fine flyaway hairs, no plastic skin, no overly clean beauty retouching, no text, no watermark, no extra people.

promptZh: 创作一张超写实的特写摄影肖像，主角为 一位 20 岁出头的年轻东亚女性，她转头越过裸露的肩膀，神情平静且略显疏离地直视镜头。构图采用 4:5 竖构图，从胸部上方到头顶，面部略微偏左，肩膀背向镜头，头部向观众方向转回。她拥有 深棕黑色头发，随意盘成凌乱的发髻，几缕发丝垂落在额头和脸颊上，杏仁状的深色眼睛，自然的眉毛，挺直精致的鼻梁，柔软饱满的嘴唇，淡淡的脸颊痣，清晰的毛孔，细腻的皮肤纹理，淡淡的眼下细节，自然的皮肤光泽，无浓妆。她穿着 一件灰色细肩带吊带衫，肩部露出一根肩带。使用来自后方和相机左侧的暖色调午后定向阳光，在头发、脸颊、下颌线、颈部和肩部勾勒出金色的轮廓光，面部呈现明暗对照效果：一侧柔和受光，另一侧落入柔和的阴影中。增加眼睛中真实的镜面高光，背光下细小的飞散发丝，空气中轻微的薄雾，以及背景为模糊的深色室内，具有强烈的浅景深和奶油般的虚化效果。拍摄风格如同 85mm 大光圈镜头下的亲密电影肖像，自然色彩分级，暖色高光，柔和阴影，高动态范围但不过分干净。强调准确的面部结构和稳定的面部特征：清晰的眉弓、眼间距、鼻梁、人中、下颌线、颧骨平面和颈部解剖结构。避免塑料感皮肤、平坦的正面光、美颜修图、夸张的美颜滤镜、过度锐化、人工对称、多余的珠宝、文字、水印或摄影棚背景。
